items.title: Add 22 WOWII numbered conjectures (batches 3-9, part 1/2)

labels.name: awaiting-author
labels.description: The author should answer a question or perform changes. Reply when done.

items.body:
This PR adds **22 WOWII numbered-conjecture formalizations** from our internal batches 3-9.

Part **1 of 2** of splitting our internal batch `wowii-batches-3-9` (49 files total after excluding one held back) into two reviewer-manageable PRs grouped semantically: this PR covers the `GraphConjecture<N>.lean` files indexed by individual WOWII conjecture numbers; the companion PR (#3821) covers the `Graph<InvariantName>.lean` files organized by graph invariant topic.

### Conjecture numbers in this PR
7, 18, 31, 36, 59, 61, 65, 100, 101, 103, 109, 133, 142, 143, 144, 145, 146, 160, 217, 291, 314, 315

**Status distribution (per WOWII website):** T = 3, R = 1, F = 1, O = 17.

### Guarantees
- Every file includes the **verbatim conjecture statement** from DeLaViña's WOWII page in the module docstring, along with the canonical source URL. Reviewers can verify the formalization matches the source without navigating away from the diff.
- Statements match the current authoritative website (re-audited against the canonical source JSON we maintain in our private repo).

### Notes
- `GraphConjecture315.lean` already exists on `main`; this PR extends it with the verbatim-statement docstring, additional definitions (total dominating sets, pendant vertices, well-totally-dominated), and the conjecture statement.
- The file `GraphConjecture199.lean` is intentionally omitted here because an earlier version is already under review in #3796 (`wowii-batch-2`). Additional test lemmas for Conjecture 199 will be submitted as a follow-up after #3796 merges.

### Related
- #3795 (batch 1, merged)
- #3796 (batch 2, open)
- Companion PR: #3821 (this batch, part 2/2 — named `Graph<InvariantName>` files)
